integrity: Exact inequalities and contractions prove the theorem; finite computations are diagnostics rather than infinite certificates. Prior-literature novelty is provisional, subject to independent comparison.
scientific_limitations: Strong-feedback sufficient condition only; general endpoint behavior and small-feedback regime not classified. The graph is smooth, but the escape-coordinate conjugacy is asserted only as a homeomorphism. The qualitative invariant-graph result overlaps general stable-manifold theory, and a plausible general reference could not be compared in full.
title: A global escape coordinate and sharp large-feedback collapse in a three-dimensional sine map
